svg.aria-label: Gerver's sofa G between the lines y = 0 and y = 1 of the strip H, with seven of its supporting hallways, turned by 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75 and 90 degrees, shaded in translucent grey; G is the part of H that lies in all of them, where the shading is darkest
